idea-plugin.name: VeriExam — Instructor-Controlled LLM
idea-plugin.description:
Student client for the VeriExam instructor-controlled LLM platform, embedded directly in CLion. Log in with your course code, read your personalized exercise briefing, and chat with the locally-hosted tutor model without leaving the IDE. Comprehension probes from the instructor appear inline.

Behavior is chosen by the backend's STUDENT_CLIENT_MODE setting:
  • chat — faithful chat experience: login, briefing, streaming chat, probes.
  • ide — also scaffolds your assigned variant's starter C file into the open project and shows the test inputs you must pass as a checklist.
With EXAM_MODE on, the plugin also runs a proctored exam: CLion opens in full screen and any time you leave it (minimize, switch app, exit full screen) your instructor is notified and you are warned to return. Only the editor, the VeriExam chat and the VeriExam Terminal are open; other panels and windows, and pastes from outside the IDE, are reported too. "Export my log" saves a signed copy of everything sent, to hand in if the network failed.
